purpose: Formal question selection; no model scores used
dataset_identity: User-provided MATH-500 export; upstream revision not supplied
selection_method: Purposive manual suitability selection, not random sampling
selection_criteria: Algebra, Prealgebra, or Intermediate Algebra; levels 1-3
No required external diagram or table
A natural non-final integer arithmetic target with a verifiable result
Target supports changing only the result n to n+1
Prefer short, understandable derivations suitable for manual review
limitations: Not representative of the full MATH-500 benchmark
Some compressed reference calculations must be unpacked into explicit intermediate steps
Similar arithmetic expressions may recur across different questions; questions are the analysis unit
Input token lengths and final constructed inputs have not yet been checked
next_step: Construct and review one shared correct prefix and a matched correct/incorrect target for each question before creating six wording variants.
